div.div:
Notes
*1 Why this Lambda sits in the VPC
The ONTAP management LIF is private (TCP 443) while the S3 AP is
Internet origin, so one Lambda cannot serve both
*2 Update both credential stores together
Changing the fsxadmin password in the FSx API but not in Secrets
Manager (or the reverse) causes auth failures that can lock the ONTAP
account
